verdict: No blocking problems found. Check it against the intent anyway:
a horizon needs silhouette, a prop needs to read from every angle.
LOOK at views.png before building: generated meshes copy the reference's floor,
cables and loose props, and glass comes out as an opaque slab. Numbers miss both.
decision: Saved clean export for a decorative closed shelter; 15,528 triangles divided among seven meshes, each below Roblox's 10,000-triangle per-mesh limit.
